verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs say the data retention period can be customized on all paid plans and that users can control how long data is kept in their account, which covers the retention half of the story. There is no evidence of user-initiated data deletion, such as deleting items, occurrences or person data through the UI or API, and retention control appears limited to paid plans. Missing for 10: documented user-controlled deletion (UI/API), retention control on free tiers, detail on retention granularity, independent corroboration.
